value.rationale: A complete classification determines which discrete scalar contraction factors can be repeatedly stochastically rounded without any extra distributional error beyond one final rounding, in sharp contrast to generic unbiasedness. The stopping-time law quantifies a nonconstant lattice-phase overhead for reaching the exactly represented zero; the three-point converse specifies the sharp design boundary. These are structural and stopping-time results for a motivated numerical quantization model, not arbitrary sliced computations.
